replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. You start by standardizing the data, then compute the covariance matrix. Next, you calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. The eigenvectors with the highest eigenvalues are the principal components. You can then project the data onto these principal components to reduce the dimensionality. While the mathematics can be complex, you don't need to understand all the details to use PCA effectively.
